title: Integration caveat: skimSurplus return value (post-swap underlying delivered) can diverge from the sum of SurplusSkimmed.amount events (pre-swap vault-asset snapshot)
foldingDecision: RETAINED STANDALONE (not folded). DEDUP-020 is a DISTINCT facet (return = post-swap delivered underlying vs SurplusSkimmed EVENT = pre-swap vault-asset snapshot) from open ledger L-06 (return-value path-dependence: fast vs buffered) and adjacent L-05 (event under-represents beneficiaries). L-06/L-05 were NOT re-flagged this run (no carryover stub), so folding this new facet into a dormant prior-run entry would bury it. Per Law-1 recall it is surfaced as a standalone QA item with an explicit cross-reference rather than consolidated out of view.
description: skimSurplus returns the post-swap underlying actually delivered, while SurplusSkimmed events carry the pre-swap snapshot in vault-asset terms; these can diverge by the AMM execution gap. A downstream consumer (e.g. stableYieldAccumulator) that assumes equality of the return value and the event amount would mis-account.
impact: None on this contract; an integration accounting hazard for a downstream consumer that wrongly assumes return == event sum.
likelihood: Downstream mis-accounting only; documented in NatSpec.
assumptions: A downstream consumer assumes equality of return value and event amount.
justification: NEW informational/QA integration caveat. Documented in NatSpec, so QA. Distinct facet from open L-06/L-05 (delivered-vs-snapshot rather than fast-vs-buffered path); retained standalone with cross-reference rather than folded into a dormant, non-re-flagged ledger entry.
recommendation: Document that the skimSurplus return value (post-swap delivered) and SurplusSkimmed event amount (pre-swap snapshot) are not equal; downstream integrators must reconcile on the return value.
